Instructions for Use
Device description: The Ember DBS System is a deep brain stimulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
The Ember DBS System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5T and 3.0T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum gradient slew rate of 200 T/m/s per axis.
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- B1+RMS of 3.2 microtesla or less; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 1.5 W/kg.
- Scan for up to 60 minutes.
3 T scanning conditions:
- B1+rms must not exceed 1 μT.
- WB-SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 60 min.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: Therapy OFF.
The image artifact extends approximately 10 mm from the device.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
